title: A finite algebra over a Nagata ring is Nagata
statement: Let $R$ be a Nagata ring [def-weil-pbc-nagata-ring] and let $\varphi:R\to S$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings making $S$ a finitely generated $R$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. Then $S$ is a Nagata ring: $S$ is Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and for every prime ideal $\mathfrak q\subset S$ the domain $S/\mathfrak q$ is N-2 [def-weil-pbc-japanese-domain]. In particular, for every ideal $I\subseteq R$ the quotient ring $R/I$ is a Nagata ring.
